title: fable-engine: a framework-free engine for interactive narratives with offline export and CSTA mapping
description: A tiny, dependency-free TypeScript engine for interactive branching narratives. It plays stories in a Canvas 2D player, exports each story as a single self-contained offline HTML file (file over app), and deterministically maps narrative structure onto the four CSTA computational-thinking pillars. Developed within the RemidiAção platform (PPGIE/UFRGS) to operationalize the remediation of written texts into interactive digital narratives.
